name: Pathfinder Orbiter
description: A dependable science orbiter that circles Mars and never lands. It can Survey the planet, which lowers the landing risk of the known Landing Sites and reveals new ones, or study the atmosphere and climate from orbit instead. It is the cheapest way to start earning Science at Mars.

name: Prospector Lander
description: A stationary lander that comes down at a Landing Site through entry, descent and landing, and stays where it lands. It studies the rocks and weather around it, earning more Science than an orbiter, but it can't move and pays only a small Research Grant.

name: Pinpoint Lander
description: A lander with a precision guidance system that steers it clear of hazards on the way down, so it lands with much less risk than the Prospector. Its technology is built but has never flown, so until it is Flight-proven it costs more and is more likely to fail in service.

name: Trailblazer Rover
description: A rover that lands at a Landing Site and drives around it. It can stay close and analyse soil, which pays a Research Grant, drive long traverses that find more Science but pay no grant, or drill and cache samples for a later Mission to bring home. It can't reach the other Landing Sites.

name: Endurance Rover
description: A longer-lived successor to the Trailblazer, with the same Activities and a lower chance of failing in service. It must go through Development before it can fly, and until it is Flight-proven it costs more and is more likely to fail.

name: Courier Relay
description: An orbiter carrying a high-capacity communications relay. While it operates, everything on the surface, Assets and Crew, sends home far more of what it finds, which raises their Ongoing Research. It can also Survey or do research of its own from orbit. A second relay adds nothing.

name: Wellspring Fuel Plant
description: A landed plant that makes ascent propellant from the Martian atmosphere at its Landing Site, on every day it operates. The propellant builds up there from Turn to Turn, and Crew need it to leave the surface and come home. It earns no Science itself.

name: Haven Module
description: A landed home for Crew at its Landing Site. Living in it greatly slows the Health they lose to time at Mars, and it lands with a store of Supplies that it holds for them. It does nothing without Crew beside it and earns no Science itself.

name: Curie Station
description: A landed laboratory that analyses what the rovers and Crew at its Landing Site collect, which raises their Research Grants while it operates. Their Science and Public Support stay the same, it adds nothing at other Landing Sites, and it earns no Science itself.

name: Kestrel Lifter
description: A small rocket that lands beside cached samples and waits. On a later Turn you choose, it launches them through Mars ascent to meet an Earth return orbiter in Mars orbit, which brings them home. It does no research.

name: Albatross Orbiter
description: An orbiter that waits in Mars orbit for samples launched by an ascent vehicle, catches them in the rendezvous and flies them home to Earth on a later Turn you choose. It does no research.
